details: In retaliation for US-Israel military actions, Iran has disrupted commercial vessel transit through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy chokepoint. While no commercial vessels transited in the past 24 hours as of one report, Aramco Trading and Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) have reportedly succeeded in transporting oil cargoes, suggesting a partial reopening. This disruption has sent shockwaves through energy markets.
title: Iran Blockades Hormuz Strait; Aramco, ADNOC Resume Limited Oil Transit

details: The United States has imposed new sanctions on ten individuals and companies, including some based in China and Hong Kong, for allegedly providing satellite imagery and other materials to Iran's military. This move aims to sever technological lifelines for Tehran's military operations and escalate the US "maximum pressure" policy amid ongoing tensions and failed nuclear negotiations.
title: US Sanctions Chinese Firms Over Satellite Imagery for Iran's Military

details: Renewed clashes between the US and Iran, including reports of US forces striking Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz, have triggered a downturn in the cryptocurrency market. Bitcoin dipped below the $80,000 mark, with Ethereum, Ripple, and Dogecoin also experiencing declines. Over $344 million in liquidations occurred in the past 24 hours, predominantly affecting long positions, and market sentiment has shifted from "greed" to "fear."
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80K as US-Iran Tensions Escalate
